scope: Operational reporting only. Header inventory, not populated business data. Approved Resultaat ownership corrections cover all eight operational CSVs; eight reporting sections round-trip. Deferred metadata and missing Teepak facts remain explicit blockers.

otherOperationalImplementation.sourceDecisions: Fuel and normal discharge remain collections with three/four member Observations. Air emissions are reachable. Water lab and parameter groups belong to Meting. Water sample kind is text; frequency reuses the existing Test-only list.
otherOperationalImplementation.resultModel: Explicit singleton Resultaat groups retain result fields, local numericValue/hasUnit and contextual PropertyValue/value/unitCode. Numeric scalar RIEPR Observations without a declared unit also own typed Resultaat; no unit is guessed.
otherOperationalImplementation.variants: Distinct conditional source variants, with original identity, requiredness and multiplicity. Generated x-related-concepts supports unified UI presentation without label-based merging.
remainingBlockers: Five TODO units: three air-material quantities, air self-control concentration and materials quantity.
The approved temporary material-code scheme is intentionally empty; real options are still needed.
Three contextual consumption stubs remain untyped and their step unreachable.
otherOperationalImplementation.officeCompatibility: All sixteen templates/exports for the eight working sections pass official ODF 1.3 XML and ZIP/manifest checks. Calc reopen/save is unverified.
otherOperationalImplementation.coverageLimit: Not full Teepak coverage. Separate source-defined sections/roles are not merged to reproduce tabs; missing facts and unspecified units remain documented.

groundwaterQualityImplementation.presentationReview: Accepted by the user: the two structural-reference arrays use linked value sheets instead of Teepak multiline cells, and Voorblad is a singleton wide row. Sample and Sampling remain inline; no extra monster level is introduced.
groundwaterQualityImplementation.officeCompatibility: ODF 1.3 XML validation passed. LibreOffice reopen/save is unverified because Calc is not installed.

groundwaterDebitImplementation.inputRule: Reported volume is required; begin/end readings are optional and may coexist. No calculation, equality constraint or mode switch.
groundwaterDebitImplementation.observationModel: Three distinct singleton hasMember Observations inline in the debit record, with source-concept observedProperty and local E_32 quantity units. The period is reporting metadata, not shared phenomenonTime/resultTime.
groundwaterDebitImplementation.remainingGaps: The example's gewonnen category and spui-included flag still need review; existing debit types are not recoded by label.

groundwaterLevelImplementation.observationModel: One riepr:Observatie with a required singleton reference point and source-owned required riepr:Resultaat (sosa:Result and qb:Observation). Feature/time/reference stay outside; literal depth/unit, method and conditional contextual PropertyValues stay inside the result.
groundwaterLevelImplementation.componentModel: Depth uses qudt:numericValue/qudt:hasUnit, method uses schema:measurementMethod. Other characteristics use schema:additionalProperty/PropertyValue, existing field-concept propertyID, typed value and applicable unitCode.
groundwaterLevelImplementation.remainingGaps: Distance to ground level is missing. A physical instrument is not assumed equivalent to method. One datetime cell differs from the reference's separate date/time columns.

confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.qualityMeasurementGrouping: One existing kwaliteitsmeting represents one monster and its analysis collection. Do not add Monsteranalyses or another repeatable monster layer. Any overarching grouping of multiple monsters remains out of scope.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.sampling: A distinct sosa:Sampling activity owns sampling metadata, separate from the Sample and its laboratory observations.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.sampleNumber: String value with dcterms:identifier, retaining the existing published concept URI.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.detectionInformation: An above/below detection qualifier, not a numeric threshold; a new inline list in operationeel_misc.csv is approved.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.resultUnit: mg/L (csor_eenheid:E_1) for the current six chemical parameters; this does not approve additional parameters or units.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.debitInput: Required reported volume, optional begin/end readings; three approved source edits applied, removing NaN conditions and adding member relations.
confirmedGroundwaterDecisions.levelResult: Required depth and exactly one required reference point. Source-owned Resultaat contains all six original result characteristics with standards-based predicates; pump-state conditions remain active.
